style: Cinematic 16:9 widescreen matte painting, photoreal-painterly hybrid, desaturated palette of deep teal, ash grey and dim amber, volumetric haze, heavy film grain, strong vignette, low-key lighting, shallow depth of field, quiet and oppressive stillness. images.prompt: A vast dark plain at the very last light of dusk, seen from a low vantage. Five colossal monolithic structures of different geometries stand at wildly different distances across it, receding to the horizon — the nearest close and enormous and lit from within by a warm amber glow, the farthest a barely visible silhouette. A heavy sky of iron cloud above, faint mist across the ground. Overwhelming scale, ominous procession, a sense of a sequence of things that were built one after another. No people.
